text:
Olivia (finance): Quick question — for Private/VPC/on‑prem deals, how are we surface billing cloud pass‑throughs (egress, KMS) and per‑GPU vendor license fees? A few APAC customers assumed these were included in the committed capacity price :thinking:
Arjun (infra): We currently emit cloud costs to the team metering, but not at the granularity customers need. Recommend a pass‑through invoice line for 'Cloud egress (estimated)' + a separate '3rd‑party GPU license' line. Keeps transparency and avoids hiding variable costs.
Hana (sales-ops): Customers hate surprise lines but also want predictable TCO. For committed/reserved capacity we could amortize vendor license into the monthly commitment as an optional "license surcharge" line (explicit on quote). For purely BYO infra, pass through.
BillingBot: Generated sample invoice lines for a 4‑GPU reserved node (example numbers):
```
Description,Qty,Unit,$/unit,Amount
Reserved GPU Capacity (4x A100-80GB),1,month,$4,800,$4,800
3rd-party GPU License (vendorX),4,month,$300,$1,200
Cloud egress (estimate, 1TB/mo),1,month,$250,$250
KMS key ops (per 10k),1,month,$15,$15
Total (pre-tax),,,$6,265
```
Lena (procurement): We should try to negotiate vendor license terms as "reseller" or "enterprise"
discounts for committed customers — that lets us absorb some cost into the commitment and avoid a visible surcharge. But we need a clear cost basis for accounting.
Marta (acct): If we pass through egress + KMS, we need to ensure tax & VAT handling per customer jurisdiction. Also confirm whether license lines are taxable separately. Please tag invoices with `cost_type:pass_through` vs `cost_type:platform` for downstream P&L.
Ravi (legal): Any amortization needs to be reflected in the SOW/quote and the contract T&Cs: we can't silently bundle third‑party fees unless customer explicitly agrees. Add a consent checkbox in the portal/quote flow.
Arjun (infra): Technical ask — we need these meter tags on the usage export so Billing can map to invoice lines: `customer_id`, `deployment_type`, `region`, `kms_key_id`, `vendor_license_id`. I'll add to the exporter. ETA: end of sprint (7 business days).
Hana (sales-ops): For deals in negotiation: propose two quote templates — (A) fully itemized (pass‑through lines visible), (B) amortized flat line (higher committed monthly, "includes licensing & egress estimate"). Let legal + finance approve templates.
Olivia (finance): Decision proposal from Finance: default to itemized pass‑through lines for Private/VPC. For committed reserved contracts we can offer an amortized option as a negotiated alternative (must be explicit in quote). Action items: 1) Arjun add tags + export (owner: Arjun, due: 7d). 2) Procurement to open vendor renegotiation (owner: Lena, due: 14d). 3) Update quote templates (owner: Hana + Ravi + Olivia, due: 10d). 4) Billing to add `cost_type` mapping and tax rules (owner: Marta, due: 10d). :white_check_mark:
Lena (procurement): I'll kick off vendor outreach today and share current cost sheet.
Marta (acct): I'll add VAT checks and sample invoice formatting to the billing playbook.
Arjun (infra): Quick note — to avoid double‑charging when customers supply their own KMS (customer‑managed keys), we should detect `kms_key_owner:customer` and zero the KMS pass‑through line. Will add logic.
Hana (sales-ops): I'll put the two quote templates in a PR against the templates repo and tag legal/finance for review — link when ready.
Olivia (finance): Thanks all — flagging this for next week's GTM & Legal sync. If anyone sees blockers to the timeline call them out here.
Hana (sales-ops): No blockers from my side, just need the legal PR review.
Ravi (legal): I'll review the PR within 3 business days once it's raised.
Olivia (finance): Closing note — we'll pilot itemized billing for two existing APAC customers next month and share impact to churn/ops friction after 30 days.
